reasoning_content: I need to install paramiko first.

action.command:
pip3 install paramiko -q && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Build APK
cmd = """export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export ANDROID_HOME=~/android-sdk
export PATH=/opt/gradle-8.5/bin:$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH
cd /opt/areloria/client/android
nohup /opt/gradle-8.5/bin/gradle assembleDebug > /tmp/gradle.log 2>&1 &
echo "Build PID: $!" """

c.exec_command(cmd)
print("🏗️ Build started...")

time.sleep(80)

# Check result
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("tail -15 /tmp/gradle.log")
print(stdout.read().decode())

stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("ls -lh /opt/areloria/client/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk 2>/dev/null")
print(stdout.read().decode())

c.close()
EOF
